method: Built-in image generation for authored diffuse skin atlases; native UV reference only
style: Semi-realistic, hand-painted and pixelated, consistent with original late-1990s Road Rash 64 riders; restrained cloth, leather, skin and armor shading
geometry: Original male/female donor models; no Turtle shell attachments
atlas: 2:1 aspect; four equal 2:1 texture tiles in a 2x2 grid, no gutters or labels; near head/limbs, near torso, full lower-detail body, far body
pack_format: Native CI8 indices followed by 256 big-endian RGBA5551 palette words, authored pixels only; no native header or model shipped
